## Hi, I'm Bradley 👋

I am a psychology oriented data enthusiast. I enjoy leveraging the power of R and Python to analyze and visualize pyschology related data sets to learn about human behavior. When I started in college, I was a psychology major interested in math and statistics. After talking with my advisor, I was directed to pick up a data science major, and ended up enjoying it so much that I enrolled in a MS of Data Science program at Willamette University.

At Willamette, my focus has been merging my interest in psychology with the toolset I have acquired from data science. My [capstone](capstone.qmd) is where that comes together.
